text:
Mina (Docs): Drafting the final migration guide + deprecation notice for v1 -> v2. Main open items: exact codemod command, example of old vs new embed JSON, and a short support response. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

Carlos (SDK): Codemod will be published in sdk-js v2.2.0. Command: `npx @redwood/sdk-codemod rename-model-arg ./src --dry` (no-arg runs interactive). I'll add it to the PR description.

Mina (Docs): Perfect. Can you paste the two example JSON payloads (old vs new) so I can include them inline? Keep them minimal.

Carlos (SDK): Old embed response example:
```
{ "model": "redwood-embed-v1", "embedding": [0.01, -0.02, ...], "dim": 1536 }
```
New embed response example:
```
{ "modelName": "redwood-embed-v2", "embedding": [0.011, -0.019, ...], "meta": { "version": "v2" } }
```

Vik (Eng): Note: the runtime will log a compat notice when alias mapping occurs. Example log line for docs: `WARN runtime: alias-mapping applied: redwood-embed-v1 -> redwood-embed-v2-compat`.

Priya (Support): I added a short canned reply for support: "We've deprecated v1 alias lists. Please upgrade to SDK v2.2.0 and run `npx @redwood/sdk-codemod rename-model-arg ./src`. If you hit `invalid_param` errors after migrating, send us the request id and we'll help map aliases." I'll paste it in the PR.

Mina (Docs): Thanks—I'll include that under "If you see errors" and link to the codemod repo and support contact. Also adding a brief QA checklist. Priya, any quick test steps support wants customers to run before migration?

Priya (Support): Short pre-swap checklist for customers: (1) run codemod in dry mode, (2) run 20 sample queries and compare top-5 NN overlap, (3) verify embedding dims unchanged, (4) check logs for the `alias-mapping` warn, (5) if using Dedicated, run canary at 10% for 24hrs.

Carlos (SDK): I'll also ship a helper function in the SDK: `renameModelArg(params)` that returns { modelName, ...rest } and logs the deprecation. I'll paste the snippet when it's merged.

preview-bot: Docs preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/deprecations/v1-to-v2/4210  checks passed.

Mina (Docs): One last nit: which exact console warn string should we show so customers can grep it? Need verbatim text.

Carlos (SDK): Use this exact text: "[redwood-sdk] DEPRECATION: 'model' argument is deprecated. Use 'modelName'. See https://redwood.ai/docs/deprecations/v1-to-v2 for steps." I'll add it to the SDK PR.

Mina (Docs): Great. I'll merge the docs PR after I add the examples and the support canned response. Thanks team.

Priya (Support): I'll draft a Slack snippet for the announcement channel so support can pin it quickly.

Carlos (SDK): Pushed codemod and helper in sdk-js PR #812; release will be v2.2.0.
